results.title: Zelenskyy: Ukrainian forces liberate 26 villages during offensive on Oleksandrivka front
results.description: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has said Ukraine's military leadership had briefed him on the results of an operation on the Oleksandrivka front, during which Air Assault Forces troops, together with other units, liberated 26 villages in three oblasts between January and August.

Irish president's office promises to respond to IRA victim Ann Travers over Provo photo
results.description: Ann Travers says she is “delighted” that the President of Ireland will respond to her concerns about a photo opportunity with an IRA murderer – but will wait and see what she says.

results.title: One week to go: unusually small list of election candidates
results.description: TEMISKAMING SHORES - With just over a week to go before nominations close, the candidates for municipal elections in the region are unusually few and far between.

results.title: Psychology says people often defend decisions they once made even after the reasons disappear
results.description: Psychology suggests that the real challenge is not making decisions we will never regret. It is developing enough psychological flexibility to recognize when an old justification has stopped serving us, and allowing ourselves to choose differently without treating that change as an admission that we were foolish all along.
